_comment: How the citation recency note reads a publication year and a manuscript's own year. Kept as data so an instructor's conventions can be added without code changes. When a year cannot be read with confidence the source is counted as 'year not readable', never assumed old.
_range_note: A printed range longer than this many years is not a publication date (page ranges such as 1735-1780 are the usual case).
_undated_abbreviations_note: Abbreviations also look like author initials ('N. D. Lane'). They count when written in lower case anywhere, or in any case inside parentheses or at the end of an entry.
_copyright_note: A copyright year ('c2021', '© 2021') is another date in the entry; a newer one makes the entry ambiguous.
